met_analysis:
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level runs roughly along Long. 68°E to the north of Lat. 32°N persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over South Haryana & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over East Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood now lies over Southeast Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood and extends upto 0.9 km above mean sea level.
The trough from Haryana to North Bay of Bengal now runs from above cyclonic circulation over Southeast Uttar Pradesh & neighbourhood to North Bay of Bengal across Jharkhand, south Gangetic West Bengal & adjoining north Odisha and extends upto 1.5 km above mean sea level.
The trough from north Sub-Himalayan West Bengalto Madhya Maharashtra across Bihar, Jharkhand, Vidarbha & Marathwada at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
An upper air cyclonic circulation lies over North Gangetic West Bengal & neighbourhood at 3.1 km above mean sea level.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over south coastal Odisha & adjoining Northwest bay of Bengal at 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Southeast Arabian Sea off south Kerala coast at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Tamil Nadu at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from Gulf of Mannar to Madhya Maharashtra across Tamil Nadu, Interior Karnataka at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
